en: The postcard depicts a sepia-toned photograph of a large group of children and adults, likely students and teachers, posing in front of a building or stage. Above them is a large sign in Cyrillic script with illustrations of a book and a candlestick. The people are dressed in early 20th-century Eastern European attire. The image has a formal, commemorative feel, suggesting it was taken at a special event or gathering.
